item.title: Week 7 Worklog
item.description:
Internship Period: 03/10/2026 - 10/10/2026

Week 7 Objectives:

  • Learn monitoring and system management practices on AWS.
  • Learn about log filtering, infrastructure health monitoring, and AWS storage services.

Tasks Completed During the Week:

Date Task Reference Documentation
04/10/2026 Learn monitoring concepts: metrics, logs, and alarms. https://cloudjourney.awsstudygroup.com/
05/10/2026 Review AWS tools for observing and managing infrastructure. https://cloudjourney.awsstudygroup.com/
07/10/2026 Create log filters to identify important operational events. https://cloudjourney.awsstudygroup.com/
09/10/2026 Monitor infrastructure health and review collected information. https://cloudjourney.awsstudygroup.com/
10/10/2026 Research AWS storage options and compare common use cases. https://cloudjourney.awsstudygroup.com/

Achievements

  • Understand how metrics, logs, filters, and alarms support infrastructure monitoring.
  • Gained a better understanding of AWS storage options for different data requirements.
